name: Timeline: ✦ Auto show on the auto-mapped Cube Wall
description: Map Sim's Fragmented Cube Wall is auto-mapped (about eighty faces). The empty Timeline says "Drop a song here, then ✦ Auto show"; a synthetic 128 BPM driving song goes on the Song row (the tempo is typed in: the detector reads this synthetic song's off-beat hats as 102.4 BPM at 44.1 kHz) and ✦ Auto show is clicked on the Song row, then Build the show. The dialog says what it heard; four ✦ rows land on the hero piece (the central screen) whose blocks travel over every face through the piece groups, plus sections, a look a section and Screen FX, well under 400 blocks. It plays at the editor's frame rate; on the render core's real pixels the picture changes at each section boundary and the tiles alternate on the beat at the start of each drop; one Cmd+Z takes it all back.
